description: This file defines a report class for Accounts Receivable Summary in ERPNext, including methods for data retrieval, column setup, and report generation.

classes.name: AccountsReceivableSummary
classes.description: A report class inheriting from ReceivablePayableReport, responsible for generating accounts receivable summary data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Initializes report parameters and runs the AccountsReceivableSummary report.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to execute report logic, fetch data, and prepare columns and data.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves receivables data, calculates totals, and prepares report rows.

methods.name: get_party_total
methods.description: Calculates total amounts per party from receivables data.

methods.name: init_party_total
methods.description: Initializes total amount dictionary for a party.

methods.name: set_party_details
methods.description: Sets additional party details like territory, customer group, and sales person.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines report columns based on party type and settings.

methods.name: setup_ageing_columns
methods.description: Adds ageing-related columns to the report.
